articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo in late October 2026, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 34% improvement on SWE-Bench Verified over GPT-5's initial release, with substantially reduced hallucination rates on complex multi-step engineering tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems at a gold-medal level, a significant jump from the 2025 results. The model uses a refined chain-of-thought search process combined with formal verification, raising questions about the remaining gaps between AI and expert human mathematical intuition.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started pilot deployments at BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina and select Amazon fulfillment centers. The Gen 3 model features improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and a new on-device vision-language model enabling real-time task adaptation without cloud connectivity.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Retail Stocking
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation after publicly demonstrating its Figure 02 robot autonomously stocking shelves in a live grocery store environment. The robot leveraged a foundation world model trained on over 50,000 hours of manipulation data, achieving a 96% task completion rate across varied product geometries.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Oversight Protocol for Autonomous AI Agent Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new framework called the Constitutional Oversight Protocol (COP) designed to govern AI agents operating autonomously in enterprise environments. COP introduces layered permission boundaries, real-time audit trails, and a novel interpretability dashboard that lets engineering teams trace an agent's decision rationale at each step of multi-action workflows.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of original projections. The node delivers a 20% performance gain and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia, Apple, and AMD beginning in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving 99.9% fidelity on logical qubit operations using their hybrid trapped-ion architecture with real-time error correction. The milestone represents a critical step toward practical quantum advantage, with the team demonstrating a small quantum chemistry simulation that outperformed classical approximation methods on a specific molecular binding problem.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with 400B MoE Architecture and Native Tool-Use Capabilities
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive open license, featuring a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts architecture that activates roughly 50B parameters per forward pass. The model includes built-in tool-use and function-calling capabilities trained end-to-end, making it competitive with proprietary models on agentic coding benchmarks while running efficiently on a single 8xH100 node.
